explication: Meshtastic is a mobile mesh-radio client, with a Compose Desktop counterpart. The principal workflow is a user initiating an operation in the app, which is handled by service and transport layers and communicated to a nearby mesh radio; incoming radio data is processed by the app. Discovery is a distinct workflow that scans radio presets, collects node information, and persists session results. README capabilities such as maps, firmware updates, NFC sharing, Wi-Fi provisioning, and system-AI integration are included where the tree supports a source location. Several feature paths are unsampled, so only documented or indexed relationships are drawn.
